nativeModel.modeSet: four packed FireMode slots at +144; slot 1 is the default mode
nativeModel.fireRate: one ProjectileWeaponComponentData rpm shared by every mode
nativeModel.selector: Data-driven: a weapon whose input binds Firemode (3) cycles the non-empty slots +144, +148 and +152 of its WeaponData record; the binding is copied into the weapon when it is built.
nativeModel.maxModes: Three with a selector: the cycle counts and maps only +144..+152; +156 is never read by it. No weapon fills +156 natively.
nativeModel.binding: Binding Firemode on an unbound input needs nothing else in the weapon data: the press dispatch, the cycle, the current mode and the value reader are generic. The rate-of-fire binding, which runs through the same dispatch, is live-proven on the AR-23 Liberator (weapon_fire_rate_selector_added).

unmappedNativeModes: FireMode values 4-8 (charge and safety states) are read-only and never offered.
fireRate: One rate of fire per weapon (weapon.fire_rate), shared by every mode.

states.selectable: Modes can be added, removed or reordered (up to three: the selector cycles the first three slots only); the fire-mode selector is bound.
states.addable: One mode and a free input: the single mode can be replaced, or two or three modes listed together with the Firemode binding (weapon_function.<input> = "fire_mode") in the same transaction.
states.single_mode: The single mode can be replaced (for example Single -> Automatic); no selector is bound and no input is free, so a second mode cannot be switched to in game.
states.absent: The weapon has no fire-mode data.

shareScope: weapon_local: every WeaponDataComponentData record has one owner.
